items.title: Here Are Wednesday’s Top Wall Street Analyst Research Calls: Airbnb, Booking Holdings, Credicorp, Dutch Bros, Expedia, Hartford Financial Services, Group, Meritage Homes, Patchex, Yum! Brands, and More
items.summary: As the Federal Reserve prepares to move on rates and oil prices surge past $105, Wednesday's top analyst calls reveal which travel giants, homebuilders, and financial stocks Wall Street is quietly repositioning around before the dust settles.

items.title: 1 Mid-Cap Stock with Exciting Potential and 2 We Question
items.summary: Mid-cap stocks have the best odds of scaling into $100 billion corporations thanks to their tested business models and large addressable markets. But the many opportunities in front of them attract significant competition, spanning from industry behemoths with seemingly infinite resources to small, nimble players with chips on their shoulders.

items.title: Bear of the Day: Yum! Brands, Inc. (YUM)
items.summary: Yum's earnings outlook has trended lower over the last several years as it struggles against headwinds facing the fast food industry.

items.title: 2 Reasons to Like YUM (and 1 Not So Much)
items.summary: Over the last six months, Yum! Brands’s shares have sunk to $145.90, producing a disappointing 9.8% loss - a stark contrast to the S&P 500’s 14.2% gain. This may have investors wondering how to approach the situation.

items.title: After Selling Pizza Hut, Yum! Brands Is Eyeing a New Purchase: ‘We Are Prepared to Make Bold Moves’
